name: deskpet-codex-bridge
description: Send Codex lifecycle events to the local Deskpet desktop companion.

interface.shortDescription: Animate a local desktop pet from Codex task state.
interface.longDescription: Translates Codex lifecycle hooks into the local Deskpet state file so the desktop pet can react while Codex thinks, runs commands, edits files, waits for approval, completes, or fails.
defaultPrompt: Connect Deskpet to this Codex session.
Show Codex task status in Deskpet.
